literal: I eat no meat or fish

text: Sili nyama, samaki, mayai wala maziwa
ipa: sˈili ɲˈama, samˈaki, majˈai wˈala mazˈiwa
literal: no meat, fish, eggs or milk

text: Je, kuna supu ya samaki ndani?
ipa: ɟˈe, kˈuna sˈupu ja samˈaki ndˈani

text: Je, kuna supu ya nguruwe ndani?
ipa: ɟˈe, kˈuna sˈupu ja ŋɡurˈuwe ndˈani

text: Je, hii ina nyama au samaki?
ipa: ɟˈe, hˌii ˈina ɲˈama ˌau samˈaki
literal: does this have meat or fish

text: Je, kuna mafuta ya nguruwe ndani?
ipa: ɟˈe, kˈuna mafˈuta ja ŋɡurˈuwe ndˈani
